scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers is a welfare scheme initiated by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was launched to support the education of children belonging to workers in the unorganized sector in Haryana.

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families by providing monetary assistance for essential educational materials.

The scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2017.

The primary objective of this initiative is to ensure that children of workers have access to necessary educational resources.

The scheme targets children studying from Class 1 to Class 12.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is specifically aimed at purchasing school uniforms books and notebooks.

The total amount of financial assistance provided is ₹1,000 per child per academic year.

This assistance is intended to cover the costs of uniforms and educational materials.

The scheme is designed to promote education among children of workers.

It aims to reduce dropout rates among children from economically weaker sections.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined.

Only children of registered workers in the unorganized sector are eligible for this assistance.

The workers must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The age limit for children is from 6 years to 18 years.

This means children must be between the ages of 6 and 18 to qualify for the benefits.

The income criteria for eligibility is set at a maximum of ₹3 lakh per annum.

Families with an annual income exceeding ₹3 lakh are not eligible for this scheme.

The application process for this scheme is straightforward and user-friendly.

Interested beneficiaries must fill out an application form available at the Haryana Labour Welfare Board offices.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

Applicants must provide specific documents along with their application.

These documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID.

They must also provide proof of employment as a registered worker.

Additionally applicants need to submit proof of the child’s age such as a birth certificate.

The application must be submitted before the deadline set by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The deadline for submission is typically announced at the beginning of the academic year.

Once the application is submitted it undergoes a verification process.

The verification process is conducted by officials from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

After successful verification the financial assistance is disbursed.

The disbursement is usually done in a single installment.

The funds are transferred directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

This ensures that the assistance reaches the intended recipients without any delays.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is the implementing authority for this scheme.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment Haryana.

For any inquiries or assistance beneficiaries can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The contact details for the board are available on their official website.

The scheme has been well-received by the beneficiaries.

It has significantly contributed to improving the educational prospects of children from low-income families.

As of 2023 the scheme has benefited thousands of children across Haryana.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has reported an increase in enrollment rates in schools since the launch of this scheme.

This indicates the positive impact of financial assistance on education.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to promote education.

It aligns with the national goals of improving literacy rates and educational access.

The government aims to ensure that no child is deprived of education due to financial constraints.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of education in breaking the cycle of poverty.

By providing financial assistance for uniforms and books the government is investing in the future of these children.

The scheme has provisions for periodic reviews and assessments.

These assessments help in understanding the impact of the scheme and making necessary adjustments.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is committed to transparency and accountability in the implementation of this scheme.

Beneficiaries are encouraged to provide feedback on the scheme.

This feedback is used to improve the services and assistance provided.

The scheme is a vital step towards ensuring that education is accessible to all children in Haryana.

It reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and the upliftment of marginalized communities.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a crucial support for many families.

It helps in reducing the financial burden associated with education.

The scheme has also fostered a sense of community among workers.

Workers are encouraged to register and avail themselves of the benefits offered by the government.

This initiative is a testament to the Haryana government's dedication to enhancing the quality of life for its citizens.

Overall the Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers is an essential welfare scheme.

It plays a significant role in promoting education and supporting families in need.

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of the community.

It is a vital resource for ensuring that every child has the opportunity to succeed in their education.
